Stop and report before touching any other path.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER — this card's own files are references only and carry no path mandate; it rides the chain head's dev, where dispatch-gates --tier at 5cd2b540 answers MANDATORY on path .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling)`, `effort: high` (rule lines composed against rulings; no build that runs unattended for over 30 minutes)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card
Thread-read: 7014518483
Premise: holds — read at `origin/main` `5cd2b540`. The card's line numbers were taken at an older commit; today `lanes/security.md` handles advisories one at a time on lines 16 to 23 (intake and ledger) and 27 to 28 (fix dispatch), and its release list is line 35; `security-findings.md` line 27 carries the flat `xhigh`; the fold gates are `execution-duties.md` lines 24 to 31; the fold line is `area-lease.md` line 47; the audit-comment line is `triage-duties.md` line 77. Each reads as the card describes. The analysis file the card cites is not in this project's files, so the new lines are composed from the card's own text.
Pre-claim lane: `.claude/skills/**` rule text plus the skill line ratchet's ceiling rows: `domain:skills` under `area:fleet`, the fleet partition of seat 1, to which seat 5 released this card (7014064164). No other seat's or area's claim on the card.
Pre-claim deps: the card names no `Blocked-by:`; its sibling #35270 is the chain head of this fold. It asks for an overlap check against epic #35205's open step PRs: no step PR is open. `overlap-check.mjs` over the fold's planned files at `5cd2b540`: one open PR shares a file, #35532 (`triage-duties.md`, another hunk), and merges cleanly, `VERDICT clean exit 0`; it runs again before each push.
Prior rulings read: fold,折叠,group,mechanism,advisory → 70 hits; ADR-0067 D1, ADR-0019 D1, ADR-0019 D3, ADR-0019 D4, ADR-0022 Decision §1, ADR-0027 Decision §13, ADR-0029 D9.2, ADR-0037 Decision §3; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack. None of the ADR hits rules on folding a dispatch or on the security lane's procedure. The texts that bind these lines are the five fold gates in `execution-duties.md` and the standing-rule test in `filing-gate.md`.
Serial constraints cleared: #35532 (open, shares `triage-duties.md`, clean today; the check before each push decides). The other same-file cards are named on the chain head's claim 7014658145; none is in flight on these lines.

Notes for the reviewers:
- The card, the commits and the PR name no advisory, no count and no mechanism.
- Item 5 (a low-severity advisory is fixed only inside a group that goes first) is written as the card says, on the card's Ruling-ref. The card also calls it "in line with" the p1/p2-only dispatch order; the PR does not quote that order as a standing rule, and it flags the line for the approver.
- `area-lease.md` line 46 (a p3 rides, at most five cards) is left as it is, as the card says.

- When: 2026-11-19T22:20:47Z
- The option agreed to, as worded: 「排在最后；没有高危、中危的组在等的时候再派，并按所属的产品包攒成一批一起修」. It replaces "fixed only inside a group that goes first, not on their own" in item 5.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgU5A6GGM3TKKSyjU28

Ruling record: the maintainer's answer to the question that the delta contract review of PR #35591 left for the maintainer (record 7025214949, section ③), the p1 clause of fold gate ②. Transcribed by the card thread that holds this card's claim. The answer was given by choosing an option on a decision card in this card's project thread: the card's question and option texts were written by the thread, and the choice is the maintainer's. The reading at the end is the thread's.

- Who: the maintainer, in this card's project thread.
- When: 2026-11-20T00:36:52Z
- The question on the decision card, verbatim and untranslated: 「确认几张 p1 卡能不能合成一单来做」
- The option the maintainer chose, verbatim: 「可以，由一张 p1 领头」. The card described it as: 「保留现在的写法，规则文字不用再改。几张 p1 卡可以合成一个合并请求一起做，这张 PR 就是这样合的。」
- The option not chosen, verbatim: 「不可以，一单只放一张 p1」. The card described it as: 「改回卡上的原话。以后每单最多一张 p1，其余 p1 各开一单，花费更多；这张 PR 要再改一轮文字并重新审核。」
- The card recommended the first option, with this reason: 「你今天说过「能合并处理的卡尽量合并处理」；由 p1 领头，整单仍按最高优先级处理。」
- What the thread's message just before the card told the maintainer, verbatim: 「审核者只留下一句规则要你确认：几张最高优先级（p1）的卡能不能合成一单。卡上原话是「p1 只作链首」，按字面一单只能放一张 p1；现在写的是「有 p1 则 p1 领头」，几张 p1 可以合成一单，这张 PR 自己就是两张 p1 卡合的。」 In that message 「p1 只作链首」 renders this card's English wording, "a p1 only leads a chain", in the words of the PR's first head, and 「有 p1 则 p1 领头」 paraphrases the line at the current head, which reads 「有 p1 则 p1 为首」.

Reading taken by the thread: the p1 clause of gate ② stays as PR #35591 writes it at head `5cb1c475` (`references/execution-duties.md` line 27, a fold that holds a p1 is headed by a p1), in place of this card's wording "a p1 only leads a chain". Several p1 cards may fold into one order, headed by one of them. No rule line changes on this answer. The answer was given to that one question and to nothing else: the size of a batch under the security lane's order line (nit N4 of record 7025214949) was not asked, and stays a remaining item of card #35270.

Grouping by mechanism in the security lane (`references/lanes/security.md` 20 to 34 and 43, `references/security-findings.md` 27), the default fold and its gates (`references/execution-duties.md` 25 to 33), the claim's fold answer (`references/area-lease.md` 47) and the `Fold-with:` line of the triage audit comment (`references/triage-duties.md` 78). Two lines depart from this card's wording, each on a later answer of the maintainer: item 5, the order of the advisory groups (ruling record 7024456329), and the p1 clause of fold gate ② (ruling record 7026582389).

Left over, carried on the sibling card #35270, which stays open: contract review nits N4 (the bound of a batch under line 34 of the security lane file is stated nowhere) and N6 (a row comment in the line ratchet's ceiling table still names the older ruling for the p1 clause). Both are listed in the release comment on that card.
